notes.title: Update 1.1.2 - Endless Mode Unlock
notes.notes:
BUGFIXES

 unlock endless mode at first load of updated build if entitled to it.
 fixed: you need to complete the last mission twice to unlock endless mode, now it unlocks correctly the first time.
 fixed: Upgraded Major's gun does not shoot correctly when character is moving in the aim direction.


We are sorry for the inconvenience about the endless mode lock!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - Last minute polish
notes.notes:
We keep our newly established tradition of updating the game before the release up to the last minute! 

This update polishes the last bits of gameplay we weren't fully satisfied with before the launch and hopefully you'll appreciate the game more!

IMPROVEMENTS

 improved alien navigation in narrow corridors
 Improved Alien retreat in the caves


BUGFIXING 

 Overlapping gunshot sound after multiple pistol upgrades fixed
 Sandstorm sound was continuing to play even in a non-sandstorm area. Fixed!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Mouse support!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We start our support history on Mars or Die shipping an update before the game itself!

We have been working on the game after his completion on polishing and additional features, trying to give you the best experience possible! Here are the major changes so far:

NEW FEATURES

 You can now destroy deployed buildings with the new "Destroy Structure" feature
 You can now play using the keyboard alone or using the combination of keyboard and mouse.


GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS & BUGFIXING

 Improved tutorials, with highlighted commands and easier navigation.
 Improved behemoths and other alien navigation in the environment.
 Various improvements in the environment for a better character navigation.
 Improved menus readability, especially for non-european languages.
 Various improvements with localizations in multiple languages.
 Fixed timer counter when passing 1 hour of gameplay.
 Fixed achievements not unlocking perfectly in all cases.


See you on Friday!
